test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

You can have a comfortable journey __only then you are getting__ your seats reserved in advance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **only if you get**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **"only then you are getting"** with **"only if you get"** to make the sentence correct.
 
• We use** 'only if'** in conditional sentences.
 
• In a **conditional sentence**, the first action depends on the second action.
 
 
• **Example - ***You'll lose weight **only if **you stick to your diet.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence it is said that, '**one can enjoy a comfortable journey only if he booked the ticket'** means **'one has to book his seat in advance to get a comfortable journey.'**
 
• The sentence is talking about a future situation so the present form of the verb** 'get'** should be used.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence:** *You can have a comfortable journey **only if you get** your seats reserved in advance.*
